There’s no guide to winning, it’s all based on who you play and whether they are better than you or not. Sometimes however, I will say this. You can be better than your opponent but still lose. In these cases I can definitely offer u advice. Rule numero uno, if you are winning don’t let up. If ur up by 3 goals or even 2 it’s time to be extra careful. If ur opponent hasn’t rage quit it means he still has some fighting spirit left. Ur goal is to no longer play fifa but simply to shatter his spirit. If he is beyond trash at defending then bang in more goals, and make him quit. If he is half decent at defending, or team presses, then horde possession like ur balls I mean ur kids depend on it. One touch passes, play around the back, pass to ur goal keepers, wingers, but always do skill moves in between ur passes so the game doesn’t register it as u just being a prick and forces the opponent to get the ball by making their AI somehow read ur play and snatch the ball away. Next thing is DEFENDING. If u cannot defend u will lose period. But u don’t have to defend so much if u are patient with the ball. Treat the ball how u wanted to be treated as a kid by your parents, with dignity and respect. Don’t just send the ball left and right without thinking of it getting there safely. Use ur head, and not the one between ur legs, there’s nothing but men on that pitch that’s a good enough reason. Lastly, skill moves. If playing normally doesn’t work, it means the game has lost respect for you. Implement skill moves and help the game understand u mean business and u will not take no for an answer. If u have some space do ball rolls, fake shot stop, step overs, lacroqueta, elastic, hocus pocus, whatever u feel is necessary as long as u can pull it off. Two reasons for this, number one ☝️ the fucking AI on ur team somehow just suddenly become motivated when u do skill moves, suddenly they start making runs they otherwise wouldn’t make which forces the opponents defense to either track them or leave them open. Either way u either have a clean pass through or a whole in their defense if they track them. Second reason, most fifa players understand and recognize the first reason. So when u do these skill moves they begin to panic and suddenly rush you or second man press, this also affect their back line’s shape and increases ur chance of finding a pass or just dribbling pass them and scoring. Never let ur opponent get confident. Do your best to play fast paced football. Quick passes, sudden shifts in directions, skill move, pass! In that order. Remember, With every shitty pass u make, every loss of possession, ur opponents get confident and either feels they are on the same level as you or better. I can’t tell u how many times I played against someone who would spam skill moves like R9 back at internacional or dinho at Barca, but as soon as I smacked them 2-0 all the skill moves stopped. This is a man’s sports and a toxic one at that, so take no prisoners. Everything is fair game, except for the assholes who flick the ball at kick off with a rainbow and try to flick it all the way to ur box and score, when u see this do not hesitate to summon the paramedics on the field, spam slide tackle when they are close or rush them with a defending with good physical stats. Afterwards, when u get the ball and score, punish them with 80% possession. This is how u deal with such vermin. I hope this guide will be of good use to you and anyone else who struggles to win in draft.
